chapter.verse: Pasian aw, mite in kei hong tuancil ahih manin kei hong hehpih in; sunthapai in galte in kei hong sucip hi;
sunthapai-in ka galte in kei hong tuancil a, kiphatsakna tawh mi tampi in kei hong do hi.
Kei ka lau ciangin nangmah ka hong muang hi.
A thu ka phat Pasian’ sungah, lunghihmawhna khat zong nei loin Pasian ka muang hi. Mihing ahi lelte in kei bang hong cih zo ding ahi hiam?
Amaute in ka vai siatsak ding sunthapai-in hanciam uh a, amau’ ngaihsutnate khempeuh uh keima siat nading ahi hi.
Amaute kikai khawmin hong buk uh hi, ka kalsuanna hong encik uh hi. Amaute in keimah hong thah ding a hanciam uh bangin,
amau khialhna hangin amaute thuk in; Pasian aw, hehna tawh tua mite lawnkhia suk in!
Ka sin liin’nate nangmah in na ciamteh khin hi; ka khituite na thawl sungah thun in! Tuate na laibu sungah om lo ahi hiam?
Tua ciangin, keimah in ka koh ni peuh ciangin ka galte nungkik ding hi. Pasian pen keima aa ahihna thu ka thei hi.
A thu ka phat Pasian’ sungah, a thu ka phat Topa ’ sungah,
lunghihmawhna khat zong nei loin Pasian ka muang hi. Mi in kei bang hong cih thei ding ahi hiam?
Pasian aw, nang tunga ka kiciamna ka zuih kul hi; nang’ tungah lungdamna kong thuk ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh sihna panin nong honkhia khin hi, hi taktak hi, Pasian’ mai, nuntakna khuavak sungah ka pai theih nadingin ka khe a taal nading panin nong honkhia hi.
